_note: Labeled fictional messages for evaluation. They are NOT the demo cases, so the agent is not graded on messages it was tuned on. expected_label is what a careful human helper would say. expected_guide lists guide entries a good search should return (any one in the top 2 counts as a hit). Numbers use the fictional 555-01xx range.
